messages.content:
Outcome: Depression cases (lower is better)

## Study A
Found: benefit
Claim: Alzheimer's disease patients with depression had lower serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D than Alzheimer's disease patients without depression.
Sentence: "Furthermore, AD patients with depression have even significantly higher levels of IL 6 or TNF α and a lower level of 25-hydroxyvitamin D in circulation than in AD patients without depression."
Measured as: depression comorbid with Alzheimer's disease (presence of depression)
Population: Age-matched healthy controls (n=60), AD patients without depression (n=26), AD patients with depression (n=34)
Intervention: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D level (measured, not given)
Comparator: AD patients without depression
Design: case-control study
Sample size: 120
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

## Study B
Found: harm
Claim: Vitamin D level was significantly related to risk of depression (PHQ-9 above 5) six months after COVID-19 hospital admission; the direction is not stated in the abstract.
Sentence: "The variables that were significantly related to the risk of depression 6 months after admission for COVID-19 were frailty (p = 0.006 for pre-frail and p = 0.001 for frail), small-vessel vascular disease in imaging tests (p = 0.033), vitamin D level (p = 0.006), and taking antidepressants (p = 0.011)."
Measured as: risk of depression (PHQ-9 above 5)
Population: 72 patients admitted to a hospital in Spain for COVID-19, assessed at discharge and six months later
Intervention: Serum vitamin D level (measured, not administered)
Comparator: Lower versus higher vitamin D levels across participants
Design: cohort study
Sample size: 72
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

content.text: {"rationale":"Both are observational vitamin D level studies, but Study B's direction is not stated and the pair differ in population (Alzheimer's patients vs post-COVID inpatients) and measure (depression presence vs PHQ-9 >5 risk at six months).","verdict":"genuine","reason":"population","also_differs":["outcome_measure","design_or_bias"],"detail":"population: Alzheimer's patients (n=120, case-control) vs post-COVID hospital patients (n=72, cohort); B's direction unstated"}
